# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 38 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_038_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 38

**1** Jesus said: "Many times you have longed to hear these words that I am speaking to you, and you have no one else from whom to hear them.

**2** There will be days when you will seek me and will not find me."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**"These words"** — the self-referential dimension; the collection itself is what has been longed for.

**"Seek me and will not find me"** — cf. the reversal of Saying 2 ("seek and you will find"). There, seeking leads to finding; here, the time of finding has a limit.

**Synoptic Parallels:**
- Luke 17:22: "Days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man and you will not see it"
- John 7:34, 13:33: "You will seek me and will not find me"
- Matt 9:15 / Mark 2:20: "Days are coming when the bridegroom will be taken away"
